nodes.name: PtMo6 Crystal Synthesis
nodes.procedure: 2.4 mmol of Na₂MoO₄ (494.2 mg) was dissolved in 30 mL of deionized water and heated to boiling, 0.4 mmol of Na₂Pt(OH)₆ (137 mg) was dissolved in 20 mL of deionized water and slowly added dropwise into the Na₂MoO₄ solution, and 3.0 mol·L⁻¹ HNO₃ was taken to adjust the solution to keep the pH at 5.4, and as the solution was evaporated, yellow crystals gradually formed in the liquid. The product was separated by filtration, washed with deionized water and dried at room temperature.
nodes.source_text: 2.1.1 Synthesis of [H4PtMo6O24]⁴⁻ crystal... dried at room temperature.

nodes.name: PANI/GO Preparation
nodes.procedure: 20 mL of graphene oxide (GO) solution (concentration of 0.25 mg·mL⁻¹) was obtained by using the modified Hummers' method of preparation, and ultrasonication was performed for 2 h to form a homogeneous solution, 100 mg of aniline was taken and dissolved in 10 mL of HCl solution (1 mol·L⁻¹), which was mixed with the above GO solution, and then after stirring for 30 min, a dark-green suspension was added to the above solution. 0.5 mL of H2O2 solution was added to the above solution after 30 min of stirring, and the dark green suspension was obtained by continuous stirring at room temperature for 24 h. The solution was centrifuged and washed in neutral. It was washed to neutral by centrifugation and 20 mL of PANI/GO solution was prepared by adding deionized water.

unit_operations.procedure_snippet: continuous stirring at room temperature for 24 h

nodes.name: PtMo6-PANI/GO Composite Formation
nodes.procedure: 2 mg of PtMo6 was dissolved in 60 mL of deionized water and mixed with the PANI/GO solution, which was ultrasonically dispersed and then rapidly poured into liquid nitrogen for rapid freezing, and the PtMo6-PANI/GO precursor was obtained after freeze-drying.

unit_operations.procedure_snippet: rapidly poured into liquid nitrogen for rapid freezing, and the PtMo6-PANI/GO precursor was obtained after freeze-drying
